USE USOnTimeProject
GO 

-- Create view for trip_data_green
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS silver.vw_USOnTimeData
GO

CREATE VIEW silver.vw_USOnTimeData
AS
SELECT
    result.filepath(1) AS year,
    result.filepath(2) AS month,
    result.*
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Silver/OnTimeReporting/year=*/month=*/*.parquet',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_RootFS',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    )
    WITH (
        FL_DATE DATE,
        OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID INT,
        TAIL_NUM VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        ORIGIN VARCHAR(10),
        ORIGIN_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        ORIGIN_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        DEST_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        DEST VARCHAR(10),
        DEST_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        DEST_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        CRS_DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_DELAY FLOAT,
        DEP_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        TAXI_OUT FLOAT,
        WHEELS_ON INT,
        TAXI_IN FLOAT,
        CRS_ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_DELAY FLOAT,
        ARR_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        CANCELLED FLOAT,
        CANCELLATION_CODE VARCHAR(5),
        DIVERTED FLOAT,
        CRS_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        AIR_TIME FLOAT,
        DISTANCE FLOAT,
        CARRIER_DELAY FLOAT,
        WEATHER_DELAY FLOAT,
        NAS_DELAY FLOAT,
        SECURITY_DELAY FLOAT,
        LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY FLOAT
  ) AS [result]
GO

SELECT TOP(100) *
  FROM silver.vw_USOnTimeData
GO

select top 100 * from silver.vw_USOnTimeData 
where year='2022' and month ='01'

select count(1) from silver.vw_USOnTimeData 
where year='2022' and month ='01'
